title: NFL injury updates: No timeline on Jayden Daniels; Caleb Williams not ruled out for next week

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: NFL injury updates: No timeline on Jayden Daniels; Caleb Williams not ruled out for next week
sources.description: The coaches for the Chicago Bears and Washington Commanders provided updates Monday after their star quarterbacks, Caleb Williams and Jayden Daniels, were carted off with injuries a day earlier.
